note: Empty by design. The direction is unsigned, and a second gate sits underneath that one: the registered split forward_chaining_by_year with min_train_years=10 refuses the committed four-year record, so no fold exists and no fit on a real outcome is possible even with a signature. Every entry below is written in the registrar's entry() shape so that the eventual patch is mechanical rather than a re-derivation, per NUMBERS_PROTOCOL.md section 5. Every value is null and every entry is state 'not_produced'. A number moves to 'staged' only after A6 signs the pre-registration, gates G1 to G4 pass, and the pre-registered fit has been run once. git_commit is left empty for the orchestrator, because agents in this program never run git.

design_side_artifact.note: Committed and re-runnable today. It carries the report-clock granularity, the report-hour histogram, the address-precision ceiling and the cause-field informativeness. None of it is a result of the hypothesis and none of it is staged as one. It reads neither 피해면적_합계 nor any duration, and its module docstring states what it deliberately does not measure and why.

gates_that_must_pass_before_any_entry_is.what: the registered split returns at least two folds
at least 50 exceedances per training fold at the threshold
no complex contributes more than 25 per cent of a fold's excess
the tail recoverability instrument passes at its declared operating characteristic
at least 250 exceedances before the shape carries covariates
the neural extreme-value model, not available in v0.1
